python3 -c "
import math

# Values in millions
values = [266837, 274362, 277949]

# Calculate mean
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f'Mean: {mean}')

# Calculate standard deviation (population)
squared_diffs = [(x - mean) ** 2 for x in values]
print(f'Squared deviations: {squared_diffs}')

variance = sum(squared_diffs) / n
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f'Variance: {variance}')
print(f'Standard deviation (population): {std_dev}')

# Round to nearest tenths
print(f'Rounded to tenths: {round(std_dev, 1)}')
"

python3 -c "
import math

# Values in millions from the data:
# Jan 31, 1953: 266,837
# Jan 31, 1954: 274,362
# Jan 31, 1955: 277,949

values = [266837, 274362, 277949]

# Mean
mean = sum(values) / len(values)

# Population standard deviation (entire set)
pop_var = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in values) / len(values)
pop_std = math.sqrt(pop_var)

print(f'Values: {values}')
print(f'Mean: {mean}')
print(f'Population standard deviation: {pop_std}')
print(f'Rounded to tenths: {round(pop_std, 1)}')
"
